pages.text: Moves items from one inventory to another.

and a tag, $(1)&$() and a part of the ID, $(1)-$() before a word that must not match, and $(1)|$() between alternatives. An array of filters matches items that one of them matches. Without a filter, all items match.

$(li)$(1)from$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: the block to take items from$(li)$(1)to$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: the block to put items into$(li)$(1)quantity$() INTEGER: the most items to move, -1 for all (optional, default 1)$(li)$(1)filter$() STRING or ARRAY STRING: the items to move (optional, default: all items)$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the number of moved items
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/MOVE_ITEMS$(br)  PARAMETER from farmChest ;$(br)  PARAMETER to storage ;$(br)  PARAMETER quantity -1 ;$(br)  PARAMETER filter "minecraft:wheat" ;$(br)  RESULT result moved$()
